claim: Penpot is an open-source design platform for teams building digital products
Design tokens, CSS Grid and Flex Layout, inspect tab with SVG, CSS and HTML, API with access tokens and webhooks, plugins, MCP server
Hosted service at design.penpot.app, or deploy anywhere
Self-hosting options: Docker compose, Kubernetes with official Helm chart, Openshift, Rancher, Elestio, TrueNAS
Penpot Enterprise is a paid plan with a centralised Admin Console
Docker images are published shortly after the SaaS update; page links to why self-hosted versions lag
README describes no template library or stock assets
